note: Functions, never names. A match says the job title describes a prominent public function as the official lists define it; whether a person holds it is for the person screening to confirm. A PEP keeps that status for at least twelve months after leaving the function.

sources.title: Prominente publieke functies in de definitie van politiek prominente personen (PEP) in Nederland, uitwerking van artikel 2 van het Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018

Prominent public functions: Directive (EU) 2015/849, article 3(9), and the Commission's list of prominent public functions at national level, at the level of international organisations and at the level of the European Union institutions and bodies
